itemUsage.en: Noir Corne stopping by to say hello with his long sword.
itemUsage.zh: 黑角扛着太刀，特地来向你问好。

itemDesc.en: Though donning new digs, Noir Corne's vibes are the same as ever.
itemDesc.zh: 换上了新的装备，气质还是从前的黑角。

description.en:
Sheathe and <@ba.vdown>stop</> attacking. When next attacked, <@ba.vup>resist</> that damage, deal <@ba.vup>{multi_atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Physical Damage <@ba.vup>{multi_times}</> times to a selected enemy in range, and immediately <@ba.vup>activate</> Talent 2 once.
<@ba.rem>When an enemy is defeated with this skill, skill activates and sheathes again automatically
description.zh: 纳刀后<@ba.vdown>停止</>攻击，直到下一次受到攻击时<@ba.vup>抵挡</>此次伤害并选择范围内一名敌人造成<@ba.vup>{multi_times}</>次相当于攻击力<@ba.vup>{multi_atk_scale:0%}</>的物理伤害并立即<@ba.vup>触发一次</>第二天赋。\n<@ba.rem>技能期间击倒敌人时再次纳刀触发技能

description.en:
Outfitted with a custom-craft kit, Operator Noir Corne has demonstrated a remarkable aptitude for solo confrontation with the enemy while far removed from support lines.
The Field Operations Department has thus passed the following resolution:
This operator shall be appointed a Guard Operator during field operations to exercise Musha responsibilities.
In witness whereof,
This badge is hereby conferred upon the above named.
description.zh:
穿戴特制套装的干员黑角擅长远离支援独自面对敌人
根据外勤部门决议
在外勤任务中划分为近卫干员，行使武者职责
特别颁发此证章
以兹证明

description.en:
Part 1: Your Map is Made for Looking!
......
Section 2: Layout of R.I. Facilities
(Hand-drawn diagrams. In all the winding lines, you can vaguely make out the distribution of facilities aboard the Island. The Training Room's location has a giant red ring circled around it.)
After Yato finishes training, be sure to check if equipment is broken. Call for repairs ASAP!
......
Section 5: Map of Lungmen
(A map cut out of a newspaper, with Rhodes Island branch office and safehouse positions marked.)
Remind Yato, go to office FIRST for any problems!
Note: If we knock and no one answers, don't let Yato kick down the door!
......
Part 2: Illustrated Guide to Nasty as Hell Guys
......
Section 3: Infused Originium Slugs
(An extremely blurry photograph.)
Originium Slugs with yellow light coming from belly. Trouble at first sight. Blows everywhere after you beat it up, hurts like hell, BE CAREFUL. Remind Yato, don't rush straight in to cut them down!
WARNING: If she already did, get your shield the hell up!
......
Section 27: Metal Crabs
(Hand-drawn images, remarkably abstract.)
Infected creature that glows all over. Don't know what part of it's weak. Basically hack away at it until it's done.
SPECIAL NOTE: Better to just let Yato at this one!
......
Part 3: How to Use Your Weapons
......
Section 2: Shield
(An overview cut out from an encyclopedia accompanies this entry.)
I know this one. Wherever the sound and light comes from, you block in that direction, get your team behind you, and then you don't fall one single step back.
......
Part 4: Because You Learn Something New Every Day
......
Section 53: How to Give Other People Reminders
Anyone but Yato: Tell them straight up what to do and you're fine.
Yato: She's pretty hasty, probably won't take it in if you just tell her once. Gotta sit her down first, then walk her through the reasons, and once she understands you're smooth sailing.
......
Section 237: Watch Out For Sunlight!
Yato's skin gets damaged VERY easy by sunlight. When changing surroundings, watch for the position of sunlight, block it off for her.
Doesn't seem to need it anymore with her new equipment. Good stuff.
......
Section 561: Yato's Birthday
May 14th.
Buddy, you're just grinding out numbers now! BUT IF there's an accident on a mission and all suddenly you forget a bunch... Yeah, better note this down.
......
Title Page: To Whoever Picked Up This Notebook
This is Noir Corne, notebook's owner. If you picked this up but can't find me, then hand this over to Yato from Rhodes Island.
Also, please tell her for me, if she runs into any trouble she can take a good flick through these notes. My way of helping her out even when I'm not there by her side.
Thanks.
—Extracts from Noir Corne's Personal Notes
description.zh:
章节一  地图一定要认真看！
……
条目二  罗德岛设施分布图
（手绘的配图，根据扭曲的线条可以依稀辨认出岛上的设施分布，训练室的位置上打了大大的红圈）
夜刀训练完以后，请一定要记得去看看设备有无损坏，及时报修！
……
条目五  龙门地图
（一张从报纸上剪下来的地图，标出了罗德岛办事处与安全屋的位置）
提醒夜刀有问题先找办事处！
另：敲门的时候如果没人回应，阻止夜刀踹门！
……
章节二  很难对付的敌人图鉴
……
条目三  高能源石虫
（一张非常模糊的照片）
肚子冒黄光的源石虫，一看就不是好家伙。被打倒之后会炸得到处都是，很痛的，千万要小心，提醒夜刀不要直接冲上去砍了！
注意：如果她已经冲上去了，就赶紧把盾举起来吧！
……
条目二十七  磐蟹
（手绘的图，非常抽象）
浑身亮晶晶的感染生物，不知道哪里是弱点，总之使劲打就完事了。
特别提示：这个就让夜刀打去好了！
……
章节三  武器该怎么用
……
条目二  盾
（附了一长段从某百科书上剪下来的介绍文字）
这俺熟，哪边有响声直冒光，就往哪边举起来，把同伴都护在身后，然后就一步都不能后退。
……
章节四  日常知识随手记
……
条目五十三  如何提醒他人
其他人就直说要干什么就好了。
夜刀脾气比较急，直接说她一般是听不进去的。得先让她坐下来，然后好好告诉她理由，她理解了就好办多了。
……
条目二百三十七  注意阳光！
夜刀的皮肤很容易被阳光伤害，环境变化的时候注意阳光的位置，帮她挡一下。
换了新装备以后，好像不用了，真好啊。
……
条目五百六十一  夜刀的生日
五月十四日。
这条完全是充数的啊！但是万一下次任务中遭遇意外，突然忘了很多事……算了，还是记着吧。
……
扉页  给捡到这本笔记的人
俺叫黑角，是这本笔记的主人。如果您捡到了这本笔记，又找不到俺了，可以把这本笔记转交给罗德岛的夜刀。
另外，麻烦您转告她，遇到麻烦了可以多翻翻这本笔记。这样就算俺不在她身边了，还能帮上她忙。
多谢。
——《黑角的随身笔记》节选
